capabilities: Show Syncthing synchronization status in the status bar
Detect Syncthing conflict files in the vault
Configure the connection to a Syncthing instance
disambiguation: Does not synchronize files itself; it reads from a running Syncthing instance and surfaces sync status and conflict resolution inside Obsidian.
extras: The README warns users to back up their vault because some features can modify files. The configuration panel and file-ignoring features are marked 'coming soon', and the author notes the initial vision evolved because some features proved infeasible. The README points users wanting full in-app Syncthing sync to the Anytype note-taking app instead.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view the status of a Syncthing sync or to manage and resolve the conflict files Syncthing creates.

relations.evidence: integrate tools in your Obsidian vault for managing synchronization using Syncthing

relations.plugin: Obsidian version history diff by kometenstaub

summary: Syncthing integration that shows synchronization status and helps detect, diff, and resolve Syncthing conflict files in the vault.
